name: Bloodmage: Bloodthorns deals its 10 base damage scaled by the spec tuning (#4151)
contract: #4151: Bloodthorns rank 3 501663 (level 26) names 10 damage in its tooltip but hits for 8. 501663 is SPELL_AURA_DAMAGE_SHIELD with amount 10. Unit::DealDamageShieldDamage passes the amount through SpellPctDamageModsDone, which includes the PvE specialization tuning aura: Fleshweaver 887048 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, BasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 with RealPointsPerLevel -0.66 over levels 10..60, which is -11% at level 28 (Eternal 887049 is also -11%, Sanguine 887046 +5%). 10 x 0.89 = 8.9, dealt as 8. Expected: the base amount stays 10 and the done-damage bonus equals the spec tuning, so 8 is the intended tuned result, not a defect. Passes on main.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
The thorns amount is the tooltip's 10
Done damage for Bloodthorns is scaled by 0.89
